newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins $51 mln GSM order in China.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins $51 mln GSM order in China.

text.p: Swedish telecoms group Ericsson said on Monday it had won a GSM contract worth $51 million from the Liaoning Mobile Company (LMC) in Liaoning province, China.
Ericsson said in a statement that it would introduce its state-of-the-art technology under this contract with the latest release and most advanced base station to the LMC.
This will set a foundation for the future DCS1800 system.
DCS1800 is a personal communications system based on the global GSM standard and operates at 1800 MHz.
"It offers a substantial addition of frequency spectrum with 75 MHz of bandwidth compared to that available for GSM at 900 MHz," Ericsson said in the statement.
Ericsson said the expansion will be completed by 1997 and then the network capacity of the province will increase to one million subscribers and cover will be province-wide.
